title: Toll-like Receptors in Immuno-Metabolic Regulation of Emotion and Memory.
figures: Diagram of Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling pathways. TLRs located on the cell surface include TLR1, TLR2, TLR4, TLR5, and TLR6, while TLR3, TLR7, TLR8, and TLR9 are primarily expressed within intracellular compartments. TLRs detect MAMPs (viral and bacterial components like LPS and flagellin or nucleic acids) and DAMPs like self-mRNA, mtDNA, HMGB1, and heat shock proteins.
